title: Piyush's Interests
content: Sketching, content creation, and horror fiction are interests. Philosophy of identity and consciousness are also interests, connected independently to Hume's bundle theory, Hebbian learning, and Advaita Vedanta. Studied nuclear energy in depth, covering economics, uranium supply, and environmental tradeoffs. Also interested in Indian policy topics, such as ethanol blending and fuel tax, with a preference for neutral, factual analysis.
